'''This youngling''' lived on the planet [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was present at the [[B'omarr Monastery]] during the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], and encountered the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief-for-hire]] [[Quar Rohk]], who was attempting to steal a [[Crystalline vertex/Legends|Crystalline vertex]] from the monastery, as well as [[Janu Godalhi/Legends|Janu Godalhi]], who was investigating a rumored [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="TCW: DYD: Tethan Battle Adventure" />
